name: Virtual assistant / administrative support (category)
summary: Remote administrative support, such as inbox, calendar, documents, CRM upkeep and follow-ups, done for one employer or for several clients from home.
whatYouDo: You manage email and calendars, keep contact lists and CRM records accurate, prepare documents, book meetings and chase follow-ups for a manager or for several small-business clients. Some roles add phone or email outreach, shipping coordination or industry paperwork such as real-estate forms.
appeal: Job Bank lists a national median of about $26.44/hr for administrative assistants (NOC 13110)
Job Bank outlook pages say there may be openings for virtual assistants who support multiple clients
Mostly written, independent work during business hours
Remote part-time postings for people in Canada exist, e.g. 15–25 hrs/week at $19–$23/hr with training provided (posted 2026-10-13)
watchOuts: Ontario's 2025–2027 outlook is only 'Moderate', and Job Bank warns that AI, virtual agents and automation may change or cut some admin tasks
Many remote VA roles want years of admin experience or niche skills: one $25/hr contractor role required Canadian real-estate admin experience and was limited to ON, AB and SK
Freelance or contract VA work usually means no benefits, your own equipment, and your own tax and GST/HST obligations
'Virtual assistant' is a common job-scam title. Fake employers send a cheque to deposit and ask you to send money back for equipment or software
Never pay for equipment, training or onboarding up front, and never forward money for an 'employer'

credentials: Job Bank: usually a college diploma, a short apprenticeship or more than 6 months of on-the-job training

training.notes: Some employers train new hires (one remote part-time posting said 'training provided'). Experienced-VA contractor roles expect you to start with little or no training.

compensation.notes: Job Bank national low and high wages for administrative assistants (NOC 13110), with a median of $26.44/hr (2023–2024 Labour Force Survey, updated 2025-11-19; seen via search summary). These are employee wages. Remote postings read on 2026-10-13 paid $19–$23/hr (part-time employee) and $25/hr (contractor). Freelance VA rates were not evidenced.

reliability.notes: Employee roles give steady hours. Freelance VAs depend on keeping clients. Job Bank outlooks range from Moderate (Ontario 2025–2027) to Very good (Alberta 2024–2026).

applicationSteps: Search Job Bank and reputable job boards for 'administrative assistant remote' or 'virtual assistant' with Canada as the location
Check whether the role is employee or contractor, and check the hours, province limits and pay
Look up the employer independently before sharing ID or banking details
If you freelance for several clients, track income for tax and register for GST/HST once you pass the $30,000 small-supplier threshold
fitsIf: You are organized, write clearly and like keeping someone else's working day running from home.
notFitIf: You want work that needs no office experience, or you dislike a constant stream of small requests and deadlines.

name: Remote appointment setting & scheduling (category)
summary: Calling businesses or customers from home to check their interest and book meetings for a sales team, paid by salary, hourly wage or per booked lead.
whatYouDo: You work through call lists, introduce a product or service from a script, handle objections, decide whether the prospect qualifies, and book an appointment for a salesperson, then log notes in a CRM. Targets are usually daily: one posting expected 10 or more qualified appointments a day.
appeal: Remote postings for people living in Canada appeared in September and October 2026
You book meetings rather than close sales
Some roles are salaried, e.g. $30,300–$55,000/yr, Mon–Fri 9–5 (posted 2026-09-27)
Builds sales and CRM skills that transfer to inside-sales jobs
watchOuts: Phone-heavy, high-volume cold calling against daily targets
Many listings pay only per lead or commission (one freelance role paid $50 per qualified lead with no base), so income can be close to zero
Commission-only listings with big unverified earnings claims are common (one advertised '2k to 5k USD per month' with no base); treat them as a red flag
Postings often require at least a year of cold-calling experience
Calls to consumers must follow CRTC telemarketing rules (registration, do-not-call lists, calling hours); an employer that ignores them puts you at risk
Never pay for leads, training or software to start

training.notes: Postings mention scripts, coaching and team meetings. No formal training route was checked.

compensation.notes: Pay structures differ too much for one range. Postings read on 2026-10-13: salaried $30,300–$55,000/yr (the same posting also lists $38,000–$45,000); a temporary role listing '$20.00–$22.00 per year', apparently a mislabelled hourly rate; and a freelance role paying $50 per qualified lead plus $5,000 if a referred group closes, with no base pay.

reliability.notes: Salaried roles are steady. Per-lead and commission roles depend on lead quality and how many calls convert.

applicationSteps: Prefer roles with a base salary or hourly wage, and get any commission plan in writing
Check the company's registered name and website independently
Ask whether you will call businesses or consumers and how the company follows the National Do Not Call List rules
Do not pay for leads, training or software to start
fitsIf: You are comfortable on the phone, handle rejection well and want target-driven work you can do from home.
notFitIf: You dislike cold calling or need a guaranteed income from day one.

name: Ecommerce operations support: orders, returns & product listings (category)
summary: Behind-the-scenes work for online stores: processing orders, handling returns and shipping claims, and creating or updating product listings and feeds on Shopify, Amazon and other marketplaces.
whatYouDo: You upload and edit product listings (titles, photos, descriptions, prices), keep catalogues and marketplace feeds in sync, process daily orders through shipping tools, and log returns and damaged-shipment claims. Some roles add customer emails; senior roles add marketplace reporting, SEO and ERP or CRM integration.
appeal: Mostly written, detail-focused computer work
Shopify and Amazon Seller Central skills are named as assets even in general admin postings
Clear progression: an experienced ecommerce operations role in London, ON paid $70,000–$90,000/yr (2026)
Can also be done as a freelancer for small online shops
watchOuts: Fully remote entry-level roles in Canada were scarce in searches; many are hybrid or in person (e.g. a $25/hr Vancouver contract required in-person shoots)
Canadian sellers also hire offshore assistants: one Canadian ecommerce company advertised a full-time remote assistant at $400–$550 USD/month (May 2025), which pushes freelance rates down
Jobs where you receive and reship parcels ('package inspector', 'quality control') are scams that can involve you in crime
'Product boosting' or task jobs that show earnings and then ask for crypto deposits are scams (CAFC warning)
Job Bank's e-commerce coordinator wages (median about $35.58/hr) describe a professional marketing occupation, not entry-level order processing

training.notes: Employers usually expect platform skills (Shopify admin, Amazon Seller Central, shipping software). No specific training route was checked.

compensation.notes: Employer-stated pay in two Indeed postings read 2026-10-13 that include ecommerce tasks: $19–$23/hr (remote part-time admin, Shopify or Amazon an asset) and $25/hr (hybrid Vancouver contract managing Shopify listings). An experienced in-person role in London, ON paid $70,000–$90,000/yr. Job Bank's e-commerce sales coordinator national median is $35.58/hr (range $20.50–$57.44; search summary).

reliability.notes: Employee roles are steady. Freelance listing and order work follows store seasons and client budgets.

applicationSteps: Learn one platform's basics (e.g. Shopify admin or Amazon Seller Central) and build a small sample catalogue
Search job boards for 'ecommerce coordinator', 'ecommerce assistant' or 'marketplace specialist' and check whether the role is really remote
Offer listing clean-up or order and returns admin to small online shops as a freelancer
Refuse any job that asks you to receive and reship parcels or to deposit money to unlock tasks
fitsIf: You like tidy data, online shopping systems and steady behind-the-scenes computer work.
notFitIf: You need a fully remote entry-level job right away or dislike repetitive detail work.

appeal: Free to join, with unlimited development stores for practice and client builds

name: Digital help for local small businesses (category)
summary: Freelance help for local shops and services with simple digital jobs: website updates, Google Business Profile listings, basic social posts and online-store setup.
whatYouDo: You meet local business owners, then update their website text and photos, set up or fix their Google Business Profile, schedule simple social-media posts, or help them start selling online. The work usually comes as small paid jobs or a monthly retainer that you arrange yourself.
appeal: Ontario's publicly funded Digital Main Street squads offered this kind of help (website creation, Google Business Profiles, social media, e-commerce), which shows the need
An Ontario government discussion paper said 40% of Ontario small businesses had no website
BDC's 2026 study found 96% of SMEs were investing in digital technology in 2025
Flexible, local, part-time work where face-to-face meetings build trust
watchOuts: Subsidies that paid for this help have shrunk: the federal CDAP stopped new advisor-grant applications in February 2024, and Brampton reported in 2025 that the future of Ontario's Digital Main Street grants was awaiting provincial updates
Where free government-funded squads still run, they offer similar help at no cost
You must find clients, set prices and chase invoices yourself; no source gave typical rates
Most businesses already have some web presence (89% in 2021, per Statistics Canada), so the work is often fixing and updating rather than building from scratch
Register for GST/HST once taxable revenue passes $30,000 in a quarter or over four consecutive quarters

compensation.notes: No reliable Canadian rate data was found for this kind of freelance work. You set your own prices.

reliability.notes: Depends on finding and keeping local clients. Retainers (monthly posting or updates) are steadier than one-off jobs.

applicationSteps: Pick two or three services you can do well, such as Google Business Profile setup, website text and photo updates, or a monthly social-post package
Practise on a friend's or community group's listing and keep before-and-after examples
Approach local businesses, your BIA or chamber of commerce, and agree scope and price in writing
Check whether a free Digital Main Street squad or local business centre already serves your area
Track income for tax and GST/HST
fitsIf: You are comfortable explaining technology to non-technical owners and want local, flexible freelance work.
notFitIf: You want a steady paycheque or dislike selling your own services.

name: Spreadsheet & data clean-up freelancing (category)
summary: Freelance work tidying, entering and organizing business data in spreadsheets: removing duplicates, fixing formats, building simple formulas and reports.
whatYouDo: You take messy customer lists, inventory sheets or exported records and clean them: removing duplicates, standardizing names and dates, splitting or merging columns, and entering missing data from source documents. More skilled freelancers add formulas, pivot tables and simple dashboards.
appeal: Quiet, independent, text-only work with no calls
You can start small with fixed-price projects
Spreadsheet skills pay more than plain data entry: Upwork's median is about $20/hr for Excel experts versus $13/hr for data entry (currency not stated)
Job Bank lists a national median of about $23.50/hr for employed data entry clerks
watchOuts: Job Bank rates Ontario's 2025–2027 outlook for data entry clerks as Limited because employment is declining
Job Bank notes AI tools such as OCR and robotic process automation are automating data entry tasks
Global freelance competition keeps plain data-entry rates low (Upwork typical $10–$20/hr; currency not stated)
Remote data-entry employee jobs are rare: a remote search for Canada on Indeed (2026-10-13) returned mostly on-site postings
'Data entry clerk' is a classic scam title: fake employers send cheques to deposit and forward, or recruit you as a 'payment processor'. Never move money for an employer

training.notes: No training route was checked. Learning lookups, pivot tables and clean-up functions is what separates this from low-paid typing work.

compensation.notes: Upwork's own rate pages (search summary): data entry specialists median $13/hr (typically $10–$20); Excel experts median $20/hr (typically $12–$30). Currency not stated. For comparison, Job Bank shows employed data entry clerks (NOC 14111) at a national median of about $23.50/hr CAD (low $17.00, high $32.60; 2023–2024 LFS).

reliability.notes: Freelance clean-up work is project-based. Employee data-entry demand is shrinking in Ontario, according to Job Bank.

fees: Freelance marketplaces such as Upwork charge service fees (see those platforms' own records).
applicationSteps: Build skills beyond typing: clean-up functions, lookups, pivot tables and basic charts
Make two or three before-and-after sample sheets using made-up data
Offer fixed-price clean-up jobs to local businesses or on established freelance marketplaces
Never accept a 'data entry' job that sends you a cheque or asks you to move money
fitsIf: You enjoy careful, quiet detail work and are willing to learn spreadsheet skills beyond basic typing.
notFitIf: You are looking for an easy work-from-home typing job with steady hours.

appeal: Paid, hands-on experience helping real small businesses go digital
